Implemented and completed `removeWhere` support:

- Snapshot-based filtering with original indexes and atomic error behavior
- Non-function validation, wrapped/capacity queue support, identity preservation
- TypeScript declaration and type regression
- README and API documentation
- Required regression scenarios, including falsy/duplicate values and capacity preservation

- `npm test`: passed, 55 tests plus TypeScript checks
- `npm run typescript`: passed
- `harness_sense`: behavior-sensitive; only equivalent/allowed survivors observed
- Direct focused Mocha command unavailable; an attempted npm grep command forwarded flags incorrectly to TypeScript, while the full suite passed afterward
